title: Oozy Buttery Korean Apricot Deopbap
description: A sweet and savory Korean dish featuring apricot jam, cooked in a kazan cauldron with a buttery and bouncy texture, perfect for a special occasion
instructions: Rinse the Korean rice thoroughly and cook it according to the package instructions
In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter over low heat
Add the gochujang and soy sauce to the melted butter and stir until well combined
Add the apricot jam to the saucepan and stir until the mixture is smooth
In a kazan cauldron, combine the cooked Korean rice, apricot jam mixture, and chopped green onions
Stir the mixture over low heat until the rice is well coated with the apricot jam mixture
Transfer the mixture to a serving platter and top with toasted sesame seeds and crushed black pepper
Melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter and drizzle it over the top of the dish
Serve the Oozy Buttery Korean Apricot Deopbap immediately and enjoy
